change.reason: Public activity for the reference wallet shows persistent two-sided inventory turnover, complete-set merges and material maker rebates. V2 tested spread capture but selected zero-reward markets and quoted below reward minimums, so it could not test that mechanism.

hypothesis: Reward-eligible two-sided passive quotes may offset queue delay and orphan toxicity sufficiently to make a small complete-set maker profitable, particularly before scheduled sports or esports catalysts.

mechanism.initial_orders: equal-share post-only BUY quotes at both displayed best bids
mechanism.maker_fill_model: public prints consume displayed queue plus one venue-minimum order before simulated fills
mechanism.repair: cancel both initial quotes after first fill and quote only the complement while preserving the one-cent complete-set edge
mechanism.orphan_exit: walk full displayed bid depth, worsen by one tick and charge taker fees; if no executable exit exists, retain the orphan and score it at the public resolution winner
mechanism.liquidity_reward_model: quadratic distance score using public L2; require both initial quotes, venue minimum size and venue maximum spread; competitor identity is unavailable, so min of aggregate side scores is used as a conservative competitor upper bound
mechanism.reason_rewards_are_separate: public L2 cannot reconstruct maker identities, minute sampling, account eligibility or the wallet's actual normalized score

universe.selection: deterministic reward-density, near-term, volume and liquidity rank; never historical strategy PnL

evaluation.multiple_testing_correction: Holm across all paired-maker arms and previously attempted variants
evaluation.null_outcome: The accepted conclusion may be that the reference wallet's scale, category knowledge, rebate share or inventory tolerance cannot be reproduced with $500.

dispositions.reason: V2 remains valid evidence for spread-only paired making, but it selected zero-reward markets and cannot evaluate the reward-aware mechanism.
